report: Address 0x8888888888888888888888888888888888888888 was examined against its sibling addresses. SAME_FUNDER: the address was funded by 0xFunder9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e1f0, the same funder that funded 41 sibling addresses within the same hour. IDENTICAL_TX_PATTERN: the address repeats the exact same sequence as its siblings — same amounts in the same order, interacting with the same three contracts, with no variation. BURST_ACTIVITY: the address executed 9 transactions in a single 55-minute window and then went silent. No human signal is present in this evidence: there is no long history, no diverse counterparties, no unique behaviour and the history is not fresh.
title: Behaviour evidence report — cluster candidate, burst count at issue
